definitions: A wealthy and powerful person, especially one in business or politics, who is perceived as having gained their wealth unfairly or at the expense of others.
A person who receives large salaries or benefits, often seen as undeserved.
examples: The protesters rallied against the fat cats in corporate offices.
Many believe the economic crisis was caused by a few greedy fat cats.
He was accused of being a fat cat, living lavishly while his company struggled.
